items.title: Sister Bernice Phillips Interview, 1960-09-03
items.q: So Mr. Billy told his wife, she said, now listen.

ctx.x: Yeah, they say that. They say that child. That's what Punch told me. People used to be bad doing things, but I can't get these children to believe nothing like that. That was true. I was scared of everybody and I still am. That's why I don't mix much. And I tried to get them not to mix either. My girl was in California and I didn't rest until I was going out there. I used to tell her, keep women out of your house and be very careful because women is a deceitful, jealous hearted thing. All of them. I used to work…

Because I know all them men would look at her because they had to look at her. She was something on the eyes. And she said, Bernie, she said, I'm not stunned about none of them. She said, I'm not doing them nothing. I'm giving them no trouble. And to know, she said, the first one that said anything to me, I'm going to put them in jail for my character. She said, they don't know who I am. I said, that's right. She said, they don't know where I'm from. And she said, they don't see nobody come in my house. They…
Come back. She might have been, she might have had money of her own.
